rysh import tmux — preview (nothing is written without --apply)
  from: testdata/tmuxinator

Layout: 4 tab(s), 6 lane(s), 7 pane(s)
  tab 1 "editor"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/code/blog
              start: nvm use 20; vim
    lane 2
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/code/blog
              start: nvm use 20; guard
      pane 2  cwd: $HOME/code/blog
              start: nvm use 20; cd log; tail -f development.log
  tab 2 "server"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/code/blog
              start: nvm use 20; bundle exec rails s
  tab 3 "deploy"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/code/blog-infra
              start: nvm use 20; terraform plan
    lane 2
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/code/blog-infra
              start: nvm use 20
  tab 4 "shell"
    lane 1
      pane 1  cwd: $HOME/code/blog
              start: nvm use 20
  Start commands are not run now: they run when you run the generated script.

With --apply this writes (after backing up what it replaces):
  .rysh/imports/tmux-blog.rysh
Undo with: rysh import --undo
